info.name: cdp-api Predictive Segments API
info.description: All of the CDP APIs are organized around REST - if you've interacted with a RESTful API already, many of the concepts will be familiar to you. All API calls to CDP API should be made to the following endpoints depending on the region. For historical reasons there are REST API endpoints and JSON:API endpoints. JSON:API endpoints are located under "/entities".
